rows.en:
I'm happy too… that something I came up with got adopted for MAT's cars!

With this attached, I think accidents at high speed will drop a lot.
Let's test it right away!
Hey, take me with you?
No way. This is MAT business, you know?
It's just a test, so it's fine, right?
Aki! Go is on duty right now! Don't mix business with pleasure!!
Okaaay…
Over New Year's break, I'll take you to Zao! Better polish up your skiing…
Really!?
Yeah. Have I ever lied to you, Aki?
Oh, that's the best! Skiing across a silver world with you, Go! Wow, I'm so happy! Don't forget!
Yes, this is Go…
There's a special mission this afternoon. Please return as soon as your work is done.
Roger!
Blow up a tanker with just one drop…?

Yes… It's said to have 6,000 times the power of nitroglycerin…

Apparently just one small test tube of it could blow away Mt. Fuji.
That's incredible! "Saturn Z" is a fitting name for it.
So we're going to fire this into the Space Fortress Naager now that it's landed?

That's the plan…

MAT developed this as a liquid explosive for missiles, and it has the special property of giving off no radiation!

Because it's so incredibly powerful, it was never meant to be used on Earth… but we can't afford to say that now!
So it's our… MAT's ultimate weapon?

That's right…

Today we're scheduled to transport this Saturn Z to the TDF laboratory.
Captain, emergency! A kaiju has appeared in Tokyo Bay!
A kaiju?

The TDF has turned all its forces on the Space Fortress Naager too…

We have to stop it here… We'll take out the kaiju with our own hands! MAT, sortie!!
"A kaiju running wild right now would be bad… …All right!"
Even Varicane has shown up!
Heah!
Even Bemstar has shown up!
It's almost like they're targeting Ultraman specifically…?
Damn it… Let's back up Ultraman!!

Captain! I don't see Go!

Is he in Unit 1?
No… there's just me and Ueno in Unit 1.

Maybe… he went out in the MAT Vehicle!

He was eager to try out Mr. Sakata's stabilizer.

Anyway, if you see him, let me know!
Go!!
Where were you?

I headed out, doubling it as a road test for the MAT Vehicle, but…

what a nightmare. I never thought that many kaiju would show up…
Yeah, it's weird, isn't it? Kaiju from the past showing up like ghosts!

"It's baffling…

Almost as if they were testing Ultraman's abilities… But why…?"
The Space Radio Wave Laboratory on the outskirts of Tokyo…
There, the assassin alien… Alien Nackle was moving ahead with a plan to assassinate Ultraman.

To make the Ultra assassination plan succeed, we must not only wipe out the TDF; that Ultraman is in our way!

To defeat Ultraman, we need to study his weapons!

So, to draw out his abilities, we selected the most suitable kaiju and analyzed his main abilities. As a result…

the Specium Ray's atoms are in a ratio of 100 chromium atoms to 3,000 aluminum atoms. The Meteor Kick hits 105 G at the moment of impact…

We found he has greater abilities than we predicted…

At this rate, there's no guarantee even Black King can win!

One more thing… we need to find Ultraman's weakness!
Yes, sir…

Also, Ultraman takes the same form as a human…

Hideki Go is human, yet not human; an alien, yet not an alien. A mysterious being!
Director! MAT appears to be starting the transport of Saturn Z.
Ready! The Saturn Z is loaded on the transport truck. Go and I will lead the way in the MAT Vehicle.
All right!
Go, take good care of leading the way!
The Captain's MAT Gyro should be arriving about now.
This is Kato… No obstacles in the area. Move out!
Roger! Moving out!
Point 120, all clear!
Roger!
Point 135, all clear!

"Seagorath, Varicane…

they appeared and vanished like the wind… Was someone testing Ultraman's abilities? It can't be…!?"

"Seagorath, Bemstar…

they appeared and vanished like the wind… Was someone testing Ultraman's abilities? It can't be…!?"
Go… how's your sweetheart doing?
Huh…?

Don't play dumb!

Aki, wasn't it? She's the type who'll get prettier and prettier once she's past 20! She'll make a fine wife, that girl…
Hahaha… I think so too.
Why, you! Hahaha…!
A kaiju!?
Get the transport truck back to safety! It's dangerous!
What!? The kaiju vanished?
Hey! Is the transport truck all right?
We've got trouble! The transport truck…!!

…!?

The Saturn Z is gone too…!?
Damn it… They used the kaiju as a decoy and planned this attack!
Who on earth would do this!?
What did they steal it for, I wonder?
One thing's certain: they planned this!
Could it be the work of aliens?
Hmm… If Saturn Z has fallen into alien hands…

"That's it… It's the work of aliens!

Sending out Seagorath and Seamons too was so they could study Ultraman and defeat him… It's dangerous to take their bait!"
We have the Saturn Z! Now MAT is nothing to fear… How are the jamming signals coming along?

Jamming signal adjustments are complete!

The communications network between MAT, the Science Patrol, the TDF and the Ultra Garrison will be completely paralyzed in a few hours!

Good… Move to the next operation! Kill the Sakata siblings!!

Above all… Go loves that girl.

We'll use her to throw Go… no, Ultraman's mind into confusion. And when we strike at that opening…! Heh heh heh…
This one? Or maybe this one…
A Christmas present?
Well, something like that…
What sort of person is it for?

U15421: the Specium Ray composition line kept literal (atom ratio as stated).
